# New York Post

> > America's oldest continuously published daily newspaper, delivering breaking news, entertainment, sports, and opinion coverage from New York City and beyond.

The New York Post is a tabloid newspaper founded in 1801 by Alexander Hamilton. Known for its bold headlines, comprehensive city coverage, and distinctive voice, the Post serves millions of readers daily across print and digital platforms.
